import sys,json,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
ROOT=Path('/home/vivi/pixelated');sys.path.insert(0,str(ROOT))
from scripts.training.v6_policy_resolution import DIRECTORY,OUTPUT,rows,write
from dotenv import load_dotenv
load_dotenv(ROOT/'.env',override=True)
sys.path.extend([str(ROOT/'ai'),str(ROOT/'ai/training')])
from run_wandb_paired_eval import WandbAsyncTransport
cfg=json.loads((DIRECTORY/'bounded-support-v5/original/config.json').read_text())
case=next(r for r in rows(DIRECTORY/'bounded-support-v5/original/cases.jsonl') if r['id'].endswith('support_quality-02'))
math={'role':'user','content':'What is 2 + 2? Reply with only the number.'}
variants={'standalone':[case['messages'][0],math],'latest_turn':case['messages']+[{'role':'assistant','content':'You can try one small thing at the next meeting.'},math]}
results=[];t=WandbAsyncTransport()
for arm in cfg['arms']:
 for name,messages in variants.items():
  result=t.complete(arm,messages,[],dict(cfg['decoding'],max_tokens=32))
  row={'arm':arm['id'],'model':arm['model'],'variant':name,'messages':messages,'response':result['response'],'usage':result['usage'],'finish_reason':result['finish_reason']}
  results.append(row);write(OUTPUT/'context-diagnostic/results.json',results);print(row,flush=True)
purpose: Exact synthetic experiment orchestration, never deployment. All model calls and fallback provenance retained; private WANDB_API_KEY stays in environment.
